name: Li7La3Zr2O12 (LLZO) tetragonal — REDUCED 24-atom fixture
purpose: Battery MVP known-good control negative-conductivity contrast (PRD §Scope: distinguish cubic high-conductivity LLZO from tetragonal low-conductivity behavior). Provides the (a != c) anisotropy at minimal atom count.
notes: REDUCED FIXTURE — same Li:La:Zr:O = 7:3:2:12 ratio as cubic sibling but with tetragonal lattice (a = b = 13.07 Å; c = 12.66 Å) and slightly perturbed O positions. Real I41/acd (#142) crystallography with 192 atoms recovered downstream. Not for production DFT. CITATION CORRECTION 2026-04-30: deep-research verified mp-942733 is the I4_1/acd tetragonal polymorph; an earlier draft had it on the cubic manifest. mp-942790 (previously cited here) could not be independently verified and was replaced.
